project_context.name: Master Key Analysis
project_context.description: Hybrid product: Awwwards-level marketing site and professional data-analysis dashboard.
project_context.theme: Navy Blue and Orange corporate palette pushed to a distinctive art direction.

typography.rules: Avoid Inter, Roboto, and Space Grotesk. Use distinctive, high-end typography for both marketing and dashboard.

headings.usage: Marketing page heroes, large typographic moments, manifesto numbers. Provides bold, corporate punch.

body_and_dashboard.usage: Dashboard data, UI elements, body copy. Exceptional legibility at small sizes and high-density environments.

dashboard.background: neutral-50 (clean light mode for data legibility) or navy-900 (dark mode)

marketing_site.layout_strategy: Immersive, high-impact storytelling. Use 'Tetris' grid and generous spacing (p-12, p-24).
marketing_site.hero_section: Kinetic hero with masked line-by-line text reveal. Abstract data visualization overlay.
marketing_site.manifesto: Numbered chapters using massive typography (e.g., text-8xl for numbers with low opacity).
marketing_site.editorial_marquee: Slow, elegant scrolling text. Monospace or Cabinet Grotesk, low contrast against background, gap-32 between items.

dashboard_app.layout_strategy: High-density, functional beauty. Left sidebar navigation (Overview, Data Upload, Data Analysis, Charts, Detailed Results, Reports/Export, Admin).
dashboard_app.spacing: Tight, efficient grid (gap-4, p-4, p-6). Every pixel utilized.
dashboard_app.components: Shadcn UI heavily customized. KPI metric cards, Recharts for data visualization, Data tables with filters/sort.

marketing.name: Tracing Beam
marketing.usage: Use on key service cards to signal 'Active/Alive' technology. A glowing orange gradient line that travels around the container edge.

dashboard.name: Crisp Neumorphism
dashboard.usage: Flat solid backgrounds with subtle 1px borders and soft ambient shadows for KPI cards. Do not use glassmorphism on data cards.

motion.library: framer-motion, lenis (for smooth scrolling on marketing site)

images.description: Abstract blue and orange geometric data shapes. Use as background for marketing hero or services.
Graphs and performance analytics on a screen.
Team collaborating in office for 'Process' or 'Why Choose Us' section.

media.rules: Never use placeholder images. If overlays are used on images, ensure maximum opacity is black/50 or navy/60 to let the image breathe.

instructions_to_main_agent.file_extensions: CRITICAL: Use .js (and .jsx semantics inside them if needed by the builder, but strictly create .js files, NOT .tsx). Remove all TypeScript type annotations.
instructions_to_main_agent.testing_attributes: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., `data-testid="hero-cta-button"`, `data-testid="kpi-revenue-card"`).
instructions_to_main_agent.transparency_rule: CRITICAL: DO NOT use completely transparent backgrounds in headers, dropdowns, overlays, or any surface that has content under it. Apply backdrop-blur and a semi-solid color.
instructions_to_main_agent.component_libraries: Use Shadcn UI for dashboard components (tables, inputs, dialogs). Use raw HTML/Tailwind for marketing layouts to ensure creative freedom without rigid card structures.
instructions_to_main_agent.animation_transitions: Do NOT apply universal transitions like `transition: all`. Target specific properties (e.g., `transition: transform 0.2s ease, opacity 0.2s ease`).
instructions_to_main_agent.fonts_installation: Remember to import Cabinet Grotesk and Manrope from an appropriate font provider (Google Fonts for Manrope, Fontshare for Cabinet Grotesk).
instructions_to_main_agent.icons: Use lucide-react for standard icons, ensuring clean stroke weights.
